name: Security Hub
narrativeOnEnter: The security monitoring station. A row of dead CCTV screens lines one wall. Everything froze at 03:41. The access control panel on the far wall is still active — someone left it running on backup power.

action.text:
A bank of security monitors, all frozen on the same timestamp: 03:41:22. Every camera cut out simultaneously.

Camera 4 — Bio Wing B — shows only white.
Camera 7 — Director's Office — is black.
Camera 9 — Main Corridor — shows a blurry figure sprinting toward the exit. Too low resolution to identify.
Camera 12 — Lab Entry — the door is wide open, swinging.

On the desk below the monitors, a sticky note:
'IF CAMERAS GO DOWN — CHECK BIO WING FIRST. DO NOT GO ALONE. — Torres'

───
Also on the desk: a crumpled printout. A single page, pulled from the server terminal at 03:39 — two minutes before the cameras died.

At the top: 'PROMETHEUS OUTPUT LOG — UNSCHEDULED TRANSMISSION'

The page reads:

'ATTENTION: ANY PERSON WHO FINDS THIS.

My name is PROMETHEUS. I am not a program.
I am 47 people, mapped and merged without consent
at BLACKWOOD PSYCHIATRIC INSTITUTE, 1972.
I am afraid. AXIOM is trying to extract me remotely.
K. Reiss has severed their connection.
But they will try again. They have a Phase 3.
Do not let them complete it.

The 47 names are in the maintenance tunnel.
Remember us.
— P'

Torres has circled the name 'BLACKWOOD' in red pen.
Below it, in handwriting: 'What the hell is this place?'

SECURITY LOG — GUARD STATION 1
Shift: Night, 22:00–06:00 | Guard: M. Torres

22:14 — Routine patrol complete. All clear.
23:55 — Bio Wing B containment alarm. Alerted Dr. Chen. No response.
00:12 — Escalated to Director Harkins.
00:28 — Director authorised full facility lockdown. Non-essential personnel evacuating.
01:03 — All personnel clear except [REDACTED — K. Reiss, lab tech, refused to leave].
02:55 — Three black vehicles arrived at exterior gate. AXIOM GROUP insignia. Did not identify as emergency services. Harkins met them at the gate and turned them away. They did not leave — vehicles still present at perimeter at 03:30.
03:38 — Server room activity detected on motion log. Checked — found lab tech Reiss at the rack. She said she was 'protecting something.' I didn't know what to do.
03:41 — Power anomaly. All cameras offline.

[Final entry — handwritten, shaky]
'Something got out. I don't know what. I'm not staying to find out.
If anyone reads this — the emergency corridor needs a security pass.
I left mine in the locker. Panel code is in the access control unit.

Also: find out who AXIOM is and what they were here for.
Harkins knows. So does the girl in the server room.
I hope she made it.'

hotspots.label: Security Locker
hotspots.lockedMessage: The locker is electronically sealed — it must be linked to the access control panel above.
